label: V4 evidence consolidation M5-M13, re-derived from frozen artefacts
supported: Adding candidates does not help: top-50 found 1 more gold-like string than top-20 (M5).
Adding context does not help: full source was net 0 on the stratified 90, at +21% tokens (M6).
Question-term evidence selection is harmful: it breaks correct answers (M3, carried forward).
The Reader answers 805/989 and is 85.1% accurate on what it answers (M2).
The wrong value is a real content error, not a surface-form error: the gold token appears in the raw output in 0/28 (M7).
The wrong value maps to a different event in 26/28 on the SOURCE (M8), and 23/28 have both the correct event and the rival inside the frozen context the Reader actually saw (M11).
A competing event is visible to the Reader about as often when it is CORRECT (14/16 = 87.5%) as when it is wrong (23/28 = 82.1%) (M11).
Same-day competing events do not predict failure across all 989: 69.6% vs 69.1% accuracy, intervals overlap (M10).
Position, lexical overlap and speaker agreement do not separate chosen-wrong from chosen-right, and the two that show a gap point the wrong way (M12).
Predicate satisfaction does not separate them either, under a low-power instrument (M13).
not_supported: "Observable features cannot explain the wrong answers" -- this is universal and NOT established.  What is established: the features, instruments and samples we tried did not separate the groups.
Any claim about WHY the Reader preferred a candidate -- internal reasoning was never observed in any mission.
Generalising M6's net-zero on 90 stratified questions to all 1,986 questions.
Treating M10's 989-question null result as evidence the M9 pattern is impossible; it is evidence it does not replicate under that condition definition.
no_apparatus: A second independent annotator, hence no inter-annotator agreement is measurable (M4 blocker, still open).
Any measurement apparatus that observes the Reader's own selection criterion.
A predicate-satisfaction judge with enough power to distinguish candidates (NO occurred 0 times in 26 measured pairs).
External intervention probes: remove one candidate, reorder utterances, paraphrase and re-ask.  None of these has been run, so causal predictions remain untested.
